data.narrative:
MaverickX is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Eric Herrera and Jesse Evans that has raised $19M to date. The comparable universe for valuation consists of one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers in the climate and energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is the sole applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised of $19M as a proxy for seed-stage valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of the seed-to-next-stage transition, this method implies a valuation of $48M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient comparables at the same stage or adjacent stages within the climate and energy sector—while eight peers exist in the broader sector, none met the threshold of three or more companies for narrow filtering by stage, development tier, or valuation range.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $55M, with a median estimate of $48M. This range reflects a conservative 15% discount and 15% premium around the stage-progression result to account for the single-method limitation. Key uncertainties include the strength of MaverickX's technology differentiation relative to the identified peer set and the pace of capital deployment relative to sector benchmarks. The absence of a robust peer-median check represents a material limitation; additional comparable data at seed or early-growth stages in climate tech would substantially increase confidence in this range.
